title: Safe drinking water summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): almost three-quarters use safely managed water, one in four do not; unsafe-water death rates >50 per 100,000 in low-income vs far lower in high-income countries. Clean version verified internally consistent (three-quarters ~ 75%, complement 25%; 50/0.05 = 1000) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
